patterns.exampleArabic: بيت الرجل أكبر من بيتي والطقس حار اليوم
patterns.exampleTransliteration: baytu r-rajuli akbaru min baytī wa-ṭ-ṭaqsu ḥārrun al-yawma
patterns.exampleEnglish: The man's house is bigger than mine, and the weather is hot today.
patterns.grammarNote: A closing capstone for levels 31-40: idafa (بَيْتُ الرَّجُلِ, level 31), a comparative with مِنْ (level 37), and وَ joining a second clause built from level 25's ال-generic-noun pattern and level 24's اليوم — one sentence drawing on four different levels' grammar at once. أَيْضًا ('also/too') normally comes at the end of a clause: أَنَا أَيْضًا أَعْمَلُ فِي مَكْتَبٍ ('I also work in an office' / 'I work in an office too'). 40 of 100 levels down.
